svg.title: CodeInternX Offer Letter — Properly Justified Master
svg.desc: Fixed 768x1024 master. Body paragraphs use exact left/right measure x=77..689. Dynamic values are semantic bold vector text. Static master geometry is locked.

g.text: We are pleased to offer you an internship opportunity with CodeInternX and believe your skills
and professionalism make you a valuable addition to our team and our professional environment.
You will be joining CodeInternX in the internship role and program described in the details below.
Your internship will begin on the stated start date and continue through the stated end date.
During the internship, you are expected to maintain professional conduct and meet assigned
responsibilities, collaborate effectively with team members, and follow CodeInternX guidelines.
We are confident that this opportunity will support practical learning and professional development.
We look forward to welcoming you to the CodeInternX internship program.
Please review the internship details, confirm your acceptance of this offer, and complete the
required onboarding formalities within the communicated timeline.
We appreciate your commitment to learning and professional development and wish you a successful internship.
